title: Focus drum word stepper
summary: A tilted column of single words on black steps up one line every 0.75 s. Only the word at the arrow is sharp and white; neighbours fall off into grey blur, so the eye locks on one word at a time and the list reads as momentum.
use_when: Title or chapter intro listing 6-12 qualities or themes, one word each
Silent loop for a hero banner or social header
Opener before a product statement, naming what the product is about
Editorial or portfolio reels where type is the whole picture

look.type_style: bold geometric grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking, active word ~14 % H (±2 %), line pitch ~20 % H, a thin right arrow glyph before the active word

sfx.event: drum step lands on the next word

params.brand: any brand.json: display font, fg for the active word, muted for neighbours, bg
params.content.words: 6-12 entries of 1-2 words each; the list wraps, so the last steps back to the first
params.content.marker: glyph before the active word (default a right arrow; '' = none)
params.timing.period: frames per step at 30 fps (default 22.5 = 0.75 s; alternate 22/23)
params.timing.move: frames of the step move (default 8, easings.outExpo)
params.blurPerLine: blur added per line of distance from the active slot (default ~0.06 em)

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets: 12 words, the active word changes at cells 0.27, 1.00, 1.77, 2.50, 3.27, 4.00, 4.77, 5.50, 6.27, 7.00, 7.77, 8.50 (period 0.748 s = 22.4 fr); scdet near-miss peaks at 0.13, 1.63, 3.90, 4.63, 5.40, 6.13, 6.90, 8.40 mark mid-move. Visible window: 2 words above, 2 below, blur and grey grow with distance; whole column tilted ~-5 deg (motion.json rot about -2 deg per s mixed with pan). Ends on the first word: seamless loop. Proposed term: focus-drum (distance-based blur and dim around one sharp slot), not in vocabulary. Motion blur during the step not measurable at 4 fps. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Palette sampled from keyframes (no cut frames).
